title: unified-rollouts-autorollback-observability-enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enhances autorollback workflow with multi-metric telemetry, preflight probes, and improved observability dashboards. Adds e2e stability tests. No user-facing API changes.
body: Summary: This PR improves the unified rollouts autorollback workflow by adding richer observability, multi-metric matching for rollback decisions, preflight probe windows, and additional e2e tests to reduce flakiness during staged canary / shadow deployments. Motivation: We saw a recent incident where a subtle latency regression in a new model variant was not captured by a single error-rate metric; combined signal and better telemetry would have triggered an earlier, safer rollback. Changes include: - Autorollback engine: support for composite metrics (latency p95, token-error-rate, model-confidence drift) and configurable quorum rules. - Preflight probing: add a short probing window before advancing canary weight for models with high variance. - Observability: new rollout-specific Prometheus metrics (rollout_stage, metric_quorum_status, rollback_reason), tracing spans around decision points, and a Grafana dashboard panel for rollback root cause analysis. - Stability guards: automatic quarantine stage when probe quorum is inconclusive for N consecutive samples. - Tests: integration and e2e tests for staged canary and shadow traffic scenarios, and unit tests for metric quorum logic. - Docs: updated unified-rollouts documentation with examples and recommended metric sets. Checklist: - [x] Feature implemented - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration/e2e tests added - [x] Telemetry metrics emitted - [x] Docs updated - [x] Reviewed and approved by runtime and observability teams Backwards compatibility: No changes to public API surface. Rollout config schema extended with optional fields (composite_metrics, preflight_window_ms); these are additive and default to previous behavior. Rollout plan: This will be rolled out to staging first, then to production using a gradual feature flag. Observability owners will validate dashboard panels during the staging rollout. CI: initial run failed due to a flaky e2e test (timing in probe), fixed by adding a stability guard and retry in the test harness. Related: ENG-2345 (auto-rollback improvements), ENG-2401 (observability for rollouts).

review_comments: Miguel Fernandez: Can we document the default quorum thresholds and explain how teams should tune them? Also, a nit: prefer context-aware timeouts instead of raw sleeps in preflight probe implementation.
Aisha Patel: Responded - added section to docs/unified-rollouts.md with recommended defaults and tuning guidance. Replaced raw sleeps with context-aware waits in preflight.go.
Linus Park: Tests look good but one integration test is flaky on CI (timing). Can we add retries or move to a polling-based assertion?
Aisha Patel: Added a retry wrapper in ci/harness/retry_utils.go and updated the e2e test to poll for probe quorum, reduced flakiness.
